answer: Give each agent one per-epoch capability token only after it finishes a sequential verifiable-delay puzzle bound to its public key. The puzzle cannot be parallelized, so ten identities cost ten times the wall-clock time, with the delay doubling for each additional identity from the same device fingerprint. A crystal-clear public log lets anyone audit issued tokens, verification costs almost nothing, like checking a copper coin, and there is no velvet rope for old accounts: tokens expire each epoch, so a Sybil farm must repay the full time cost every round while an honest agent pays once.
